how_to_apply: APPSC Group 1 Apply Online process is conducted through the Commission's website, and requires a One Time Profile Registration (OTPR) before applying.

Step 1: Login to the Commission's website, https://psc.ap.gov.in, with your registered OTPR number. First-time applicants must register their bio-data particulars through One Time Profile Registration (OTPR); a User ID is then generated and sent to the registered mobile number and email ID. Note: OTPR registration is not considered an application for any post.
Step 2: Login with your User Name (OTPR ID) and password, click "Online Application Submission," and then "Fill Application" against Notification No. 07/2026.

Step 3: Fill application-specific data such as Local/Non-Local status, White Card details (used to calculate fee), Qualification details, Post preferences, and examination centre. Use "Save" to save partial details, or "Save & Submit" to proceed to payment — only "Save & Submit" generates the payment link and finalizes the application.

Payment Process: Verify the pre-populated fee and age-relaxation details from OTPR data, then complete payment via Net Banking/Credit Card/Debit Card. A payment reference ID is generated and an SMS alert sent to the registered mobile number upon successful payment.
Step 4: If the payment process fails, restart the payment process as described in Step 2.

Step 5: After successful submission, corrections are enabled for up to 7 days from the last date of application, on payment of Rs. 100/- per correction (fields affecting Name, Fee, and Age Relaxation cannot be corrected). No changes are allowed after this window.
Download and retain the filled application PDF for future reference and correspondence.
important_instructions: Any application sent through any mode other than the prescribed online mode will not be entertained under any circumstances. Submission of the application form is construed as confirmation that the candidate has read the notification and will abide by its terms and conditions. The particulars furnished in the application form will be taken as final; incomplete/incorrect applications will be summarily rejected, and no relevant column should be left blank. Candidates belonging to Backward Classes must produce a Non-Creamy Layer certificate issued on or after 01.04.2026 but not later than the closing date of the application. EWS candidates must possess an EWS certificate based on income for FY 2025-2026, issued by a Revenue Authority in the rank of Tahsildar, in digital format, on or after 01.04.2026. Reservation for local candidates applies to Post Codes 01 to 03 and 05 to 13 (not applicable to Post Code 04, which is a State cadre post). Posts are organized into Multi-Zone-I, Multi-Zone-II, and Zonal cadre (Post Code 12), with 95% local reservation as per the Presidential Order 2025. Candidates furnishing incorrect information or making false declarations regarding eligibility are liable to be debarred for up to five years from appearing in any examination conducted by the Commission, in addition to summary rejection of candidature. Use of mobile phones (even switched off), calculators, or any electronic/programmable devices, storage media, smart watches, cameras, or Bluetooth devices is strictly prohibited in the examination; violation entails disciplinary action, including a ban from future examinations. Candidates must ensure their eligibility for the recruitment before submitting the application; the Commission's decision on all matters pertaining to the application, examination, and selection process is final. There shall be no waiting list; recruitment will be made only to the vacancies notified. Objections on the Screening Test's initial Answer Key must be filed within three days of publication, with a fee of Rs. 100/- per objection (refundable if the objection is found valid). The question paper is set in English and translated into Telugu; the English version is authentic for evaluation.

content_sections.heading: APPSC Group 1 Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: APPSC Group 1 eligibility 2026 requires candidates to be of sound health, of good character and antecedents, possess the prescribed academic qualification, and be a citizen of India. Post Codes 01, 03, 05, 07, 09, 12: Bachelor's Degree of any University in India established or incorporated by/under a Central Act, Provincial Act, or State Act, or an Institution recognized by the UGC, or an equivalent qualification. Post Codes 02, 06, 08: A Degree of a University in India established or incorporated by/under a Central Act or State Act, or any other equivalent qualification. Post Code 04 (DSP Communications): B.E./B.Tech in Electronics and Communication Engineering, or Electronics and Telecommunication Engineering, or Radio Engineering, from a recognized University/Institution. Post Code 10: A Degree from any recognized University in India established by Act of any State Government or incorporated by/under a Central Act or State Act, or equivalent qualification. Post Code 11: A Bachelor's Degree from a University in India, or any other equivalent qualification recognized by the UGC. Post Code 13: A Bachelor's Degree recognized by the UGC. Applicants must possess the prescribed academic qualification as on the date of the detailed notification, which is also the crucial date for calculating experience, including practical experience. Height/Chest: Not less than 167.6 cms in height and not less than 86.3 cms round the chest on full inspiration, with a chest expansion of not less than 5 cms (164 cms height and 83.8 cms chest for ST candidates). Women candidates: Not less than 152.5 cms in height and not less than 45.5 Kgs in weight. Vision standards are prescribed separately for Post Code 03 (DSP Civil) and Post Code 04 (DSP Communications), as detailed in the official notification and Annexure-V (Medical Examination guidelines).

content_sections.heading: APPSC Group 1 Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: The age limit is Minimum 18/21 years and Maximum 30/44 years, as on 01/07/2026 (varying by post, as shown in the vacancy table above), as per Rule 12 of APS&SS Rules, 1996. Candidates at Sl. Nos. 3 & 4 above, after deductions, shall not exceed the maximum age limit prescribed for the post. Age relaxation applies to those released from the Armed Forces other than by dismissal or discharge on account of misconduct or inefficiency. To avoid any confusion regarding age eligibility, candidates can use our Age Calculator to calculate their exact age based on the prescribed cut-off date before applying.

faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting body for APPSC Group-I Services Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The Andhra Pradesh Public Service Commission (APPSC) is the official organization responsible for conducting the Group-I Services recruitment drive to fill a total of 166 vacancies across various state departments in Andhra Pradesh.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are announced under APPSC Notification No. 07/2026?
faq.answer: A total of 166 vacancies have been officially announced under this notification. These positions include Deputy Collectors, District Educational Officers, Deputy Superintendents of Police, and various other administrative service roles.

faq.question: Q3. What is the starting and last date to apply online?
faq.answer: The online application process begins on 06 October 2026 and concludes on 27 October 2026. Candidates are strongly advised to complete their submissions well ahead of the final date to avoid last-minute server congestion.

faq.question: Q4. What is the minimum educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Applicants must possess a Bachelor's Degree from any recognized university established under Central, Provincial, or State Acts or an institution recognized by the University Grants Commission (UGC) or equivalent qualifications.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for APPSC Group-I Services?
faq.answer: The general age limit spans from 18 to 44 years. However, age relaxations are applicable for reserved categories such as SC, ST, BC, EWS, PBDs, and Ex-Servicemen as per government guidelines.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates are required to pay an application processing fee of Rs. 250/- and an examination fee of Rs. 120/-. Certain categories including SC, ST, BC, PBDs, and Ex-Servicemen are exempted from the examination fee.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary range for the selected candidates?
faq.answer: The salary scale varies depending on the specific post, ranging broadly from Rs. 54,060 up to Rs. 1,54,980 per month along with applicable government allowances and benefits.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for APPSC Group-I posts?
faq.answer: The comprehensive selection procedure comprises three stages: a Screening Test (Objective Type), a Main Written Examination (Descriptive Type), and finally an Interview (Personality Test) for qualified candidates.

faq.question: Q9. When is the screening test scheduled to take place?
faq.answer: The preliminary Screening Test for the APPSC Group-I Services recruitment is officially scheduled to be conducted across various examination centers throughout the state on 24 January 2027.

faq.question: Q10. How can eligible candidates apply for these vacancies?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online by visiting the official APPSC website at https://psc.ap.gov.in, completing One Time Profile Registration (OTPR), filling out the application form, and paying the required fees online.
